title: Reading the News: Adapting Large Language Models to Swedish Journalism Through Continued Pre-Training
abstract: arXiv:2608.30609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly capable in general, but their utility can remain modest in niche or understudied areas. One approach to address this limitation is to specialise existing models through additional training on target-domain corpora. In this work, we investigate such continued pre-training for adapting large language models to Swedish journalism, using a high-quality dataset that we curate from millions of news articles. To evaluate the adaptation efficacy, we also construct a novel domain-specific benchmark that covers six editorial tasks. Through full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning across two model sizes, we find that continued pre-training yields benefits in the target domain, but only when paired with experience replay to mitigate forgetting. translated_title: 阅读新闻：通过持续预训练使大语言模型适应瑞典新闻业
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在通用领域的能力日益增强，但在小众或研究不足的领域中其效用可能仍然有限。解决这一局限的一种方法是通过在目标领域语料库上进行额外训练来专门化现有模型。在这项工作中，我们研究了这种持续预训练方法，用于使大语言模型适应瑞典新闻业，并使用我们从数百万篇新闻文章中精心整理的高质量数据集。为了评估适应效果，我们还构建了一个涵盖六项编辑任务的新型领域特定基准。通过对两种模型规模进行全参数和参数高效微调，我们发现持续预训练在目标领域能带来收益，但只有在结合经验回放以缓解灾难性遗忘时才有效。我们观察到模型在生成质量和事实知识方面获得了一致的提升，但在判别类任务上的能力并未提高。我们还探索了一种无需训练的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究通过在数百万篇瑞典新闻文章上进行持续预训练并结合经验回放机制防止灾难性遗忘，成功提升了大语言模型在瑞典新闻领域的生成质量和事实知识水平，并构建了涵盖六项编辑任务的领域专用基准进行评估。
en_tdlr: This work adapts large language models to Swedish journalism through continued pre-training on millions of curated news articles, showing that domain benefits emerge only when paired with experience replay to mitigate forgetting, alongside a novel domain-specific benchmark covering six editorial tasks.
